question: What bodily and perceptual powers result from this wheel’s practice?
premises: Destruction of wrinkles and grey hair is named
Seeing from very far is named
Both are presented as resulting attainments
inference: Practice of this wheel yields the removal of wrinkles and grey hair and the power of distant seeing
plain_english: It brings the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair, and likewise the ability to see from very far away.
